Test build of Inset Window Links. The macOS app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; the Windows app is unsigned. See the [README](https://github.com/levinbaenninger/inset-window-links#macos-first-run) for first-run instructions and permissions.

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple silicon | `inset-window-links-*-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `inset-window-links-*-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows, x64 | `inset-window-links-*-win-x64.exe` (installer) or `inset-window-links-*-win-x64.zip` (portable) |

[IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md](https://github.com/levinbaenninger/inset-window-links/blob/main/IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md) lists what has been verified and what has not.
